environment.description: Provider binary is executed within a pivot_root'd mount namespace created by the Terraform plugin execution framework. The process root is switched to /var/lib/terraform/plugin-sandbox/<hash>/ which contains only the provider binary itself, a minimal /proc mount (hidepid=2), and /tmp. The mount namespace is created with MS_NOSUID|MS_NODEV and propagation set to MS_PRIVATE. Additionally, a seccomp-bpf profile (loaded via prctl before exec) restricts the execve family to only the provider binary path within the new root, and blocks execveat entirely. The /bin/sh path does not exist within the chroot, nor do any other shell interpreters or utilities. Network namespace is shared with host for provider registry access.

config.execve_restriction: BPF filter checks arg[0] against /terraform-provider-custom_v1.0.0 only
config.network: shared namespace (outbound allowed for registry/API calls)
